blocks.label_en: If the Mother's Case Is Withdrawn

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 母亲的正式结果也下来了。研究和住处的事，她自己拿主意。我先把我的工作做好。
lines.en: My mother's official result came through too. She'll decide about the research and where to live herself. I'll focus on doing my job well first.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 反正这回上去，不再当那个什么都不用管的大小姐。
lines.en: Anyway, this time I'm going up there as someone who doesn't just have everything handled for her.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 那我可得盼着你下班了。时间提前留出来，你留，我也留。
lines.en: Then I'll have to look forward to you getting off work. Set the time aside in advance. You make time, and so do I.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 你怎么不问，我以后还来不来？
lines.en: ...Why have you not asked whether I will still come?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 我正想约你。
lines.en: I was about to ask you out.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 会来。只是不能每回一想起你，就拎着货跑下来。
lines.en: ...I will. I just cannot run down here with a bag of stock every time I think of you.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 莉迪亚还叫我慢慢说，省得你以为我要走了。
lines.en: Lydia even told me to say it slowly, so you wouldn't think I was leaving.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 她是不是把我们俩想得太不会说话了？
lines.en: Does she think we're that bad at talking to each other?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 有时候也没想错。
lines.en: ...Sometimes she's not wrong.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 我来借你这儿歇歇脚！替首饰店重摆了一上午展柜，腿都站酸了。
lines.en: I'm borrowing your place to rest my feet! I spent all morning rearranging a jewelry shop's display. My legs are sore.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 头一回把最亮的全挤在一起，站远一看什么都看不清。留了点空，连最不起眼的那枚都有人问。老板还想让我下回接着摆。
lines.en: The first time, I packed all the brightest pieces together. From a distance you couldn't see anything. Then I left some space, and even the plainest piece got questions. The owner wants me to do it again.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 你看这边，花瓣的颜色还不一样。
lines.en: Look here. The petals aren't even the same color.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 正好，把你这儿新收的拿出来我看看。腿歇着，眼睛没歇。
lines.en: Good—show me what you've taken in lately. My legs are resting; my eyes aren't.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 看中哪件再说价。
lines.en: Tell me which one you want, then we'll talk price.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 这句比夸我会摆柜子好多了。
lines.en: That is much better than praising how I arrange a display.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: ……你今天怎么这么会说话？
lines.en: ...Why are you so good at talking today?

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 你倒是会心疼人。
lines.en: You do know how to be thoughtful.

choices.label_zh: 你替别人忙了一上午，也该有人夸你一句。
choices.label_en: You spent all morning working for someone else. Someone should compliment you too.
Sit down and rest first. The stock won't run away.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 下回你跟她见面，别老问工作顺不顺。她有时候也想让你注意到她新换的发饰。
lines.en: Next time you see her, don't keep asking whether work's going well. Sometimes she wants you to notice her new hair ornament.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 你今天也换了。你教的，看人别光看柜台——这招有用。
lines.en: You changed yours too. You taught me to look at the person, not just the counter. It works.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 你、你怎么看得这么仔细？我是让你看她！
lines.en: ...You—why are you looking so closely? I told you to look at her!

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 谢谢。
lines.en: ...Thank you.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 那是我送她的！你这眼力，到底是好还是不好？
lines.en: ...I gave her that one! Is your eye for detail good or bad?

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 不赶。本来想去看新到的裙子，走到半路，又绕到这儿来了。
lines.en: No rush. I meant to go see the new dresses, but halfway there I came around to this place instead.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 裙子又不会长腿跑掉。今天先来看看你有没有学会夸人——看来学得不错。
lines.en: The dresses will not run away. Today I came to see whether you had learned to give a compliment—and it seems you have.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 既然都站到柜台前了，把你新收的东西拿给我看看。别只拿最贵的糊弄我。
lines.en: Since I'm already at the counter, show me what you've recently taken in. Don't fob me off with just the most expensive piece.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 看可以。买不买你自己决定。
lines.en: You can look. Whether you buy is up to you.

choices.description_zh: 只改变这次回应，不改变后续关系进程。关系要等三个人各自把话说清楚。
choices.description_en: Changes only this response, not the relationship progression. All three still need to speak for themselves.

choices.label_zh: 埃莉诺好像也有一枚差不多的。
choices.label_en: I think Eleanor has one just like it.
choices.description_zh: 只改变这次回应，不改变后续关系进程。关系要等三个人各自把话说清楚。
choices.description_en: Changes only this response, not the relationship progression. All three still need to speak for themselves.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 下周有两天，我能早点下来。我写下来了。
lines.en: There are two days next week when I can come down early. I wrote them down.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 上面事情一多，谁都说“就耽误你一会儿”。我不提前留出来，自己的事就总得往后放。
lines.en: When things get busy upstairs, everyone says 'this will only take a moment.' If I don't set time aside in advance, my own plans always get pushed back.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 那两天，算我们的事。
lines.en: Those two days are ours. Remember that.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 莉迪亚最近来过吗？
lines.en: Has Lydia been by lately?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 前几天来过。就没再来。
lines.en: She came a few days ago. Then she stopped.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 她跟我说忙。我提起她一直想去的新店，她连在哪儿都没问，就说约了别人。
lines.en: She says she's busy. I mentioned that new shop she's been wanting to visit. She didn't even ask where it was. Just said she'd made other plans.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 她真不想出门时，会嫌鞋磨脚、嫌裙子不合身。不会连地方都没听清就说没空。
lines.en: When she really doesn't want to go out, she complains her shoes pinch or her dress doesn't fit. She wouldn't say she's busy without even hearing where.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 她在你这儿，会聊她自己的事吗？
lines.en: Does she talk about her own things when she's here?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 会。
lines.en: She does.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 以前她跟我说起你，全是“他该这样”“你该那样”。最近一个字都不提了。
lines.en: ...Before, whenever she talked about you, it was all 'he should do this' and 'you should do that.' Lately she doesn't say a word.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 我还没想好要问她什么。你也别因为我问这一句，就突然装作不认识她。那样更难看。
lines.en: I haven't decided what to ask her yet. And don't suddenly pretend you don't know her just because I asked. That would look worse.

scenes.title_en: This Time I Really Won't Help

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 以后你想约她，直接问她就行。我最近……事情多。
lines.en: From now on, if you want to ask her out, just ask her. I've been... busy lately.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 我们已经直接说了。
lines.en: We've already talked directly.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 那就好。我这件事算办完了。
lines.en: Good. Then my job here is done.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 我又不是非得天天往这儿绕。上回为了绕过来，连想看的裙子都没去。
lines.en: It's not like I have to come around here every day. Last time I came this way, I missed a dress I wanted to see.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 有别的安排。
lines.en: ...I had other plans later.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 不想说就算了，别拿别的事搪塞我。
lines.en: If you don't want to talk about it, fine. Don't fob me off with something else.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 我以为事情办成了会很高兴。替她高兴，也替你高兴。
lines.en: I thought I'd be happy once it worked out. Happy for her, and happy for you.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 就是……她跟我说你们见了面，我第一个想的是你们聊了什么。她没提到我，我又气自己连这个都要在意。
lines.en: It's just... when she told me you'd met, the first thing I thought about was what you talked about. She didn't mention me, and then I was angry at myself for caring.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 你别安慰我。你一认真看着我，我就更说不下去了。
lines.en: Don't comfort me. When you look at me seriously, I can't finish a sentence.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 让我自己想想。今天就到这儿吧。
lines.en: Let me think on my own. That's enough for today.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 客人的事照常。已经说好的，我都会交代清楚。
lines.en: The customer business stays as usual. Whatever's already arranged, I'll make clear.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 我没问客人。你不来的这几天，我总忍不住看门口。
lines.en: I didn't ask about customers. These past few days you didn't come, I kept looking at the door.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 我知道。你这么说，我就更不知道该怎么走了。
lines.en: ...I know. Hearing you say that makes it even harder to leave.

scenes.title_zh: 不再借她的名义来找你
scenes.title_en: I Won't Come in Her Name Anymore

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 这回我不说路过了。我喜欢你。
lines.en: I'm not saying I was just passing by this time. I like you.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 那你去说。我一想到她会怎么看我，就一句话也想不好了。
lines.en: ...Then tell her. Every time I think of how she will look at me, I lose all my words.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 真是的……这回居然轮到我等你把话说清楚。说清楚之前，别让我偷偷摸摸地等。我也会自己去找她。
lines.en: Honestly... now it's my turn to wait for you to say it clearly. Until you do, don't make me wait in secret. I'll go see her myself too.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 一开始，我只是想让她过得好一点。
lines.en: At first, I just wanted things to go better for her.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 你还记得我那枚胸针，也肯听我讲那些零碎事。我越来越盼着来，又怕你只问她怎么样了。
lines.en: You remembered my brooch, and you listened to all those little things. I started looking forward to coming here—and then feared you only asked how she was.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 可埃莉诺还不知道。你得把真话都告诉她。你到底怎么想，别让她和我都只能猜。
lines.en: But Eleanor doesn't know yet. You have to tell her the truth. What do you actually want? Don't leave us both guessing.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: ……你、你先别这么快回答。听我说完。
lines.en: ...You—don't answer so fast. Hear me out first.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 好。我没让你今天就决定。
lines.en: All right. I'm not asking you to decide today.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 我怕说长了，你又要拿货价堵我。
lines.en: I was afraid a longer one would make you shut me down with prices again.

choices.label_zh: 我也喜欢你。可我跟她在一起，不会背着她答应你什么。这件事，我会亲口告诉她。
choices.label_en: I like you too. But I'm with her, and I won't promise you anything behind her back. I'll tell her this myself.
choices.description_zh: 开启三人关系的明确讨论；尚未确立双恋，三人将分别表达意愿。
choices.description_en: Open the explicit three-way discussion; nothing is committed yet.

choices.label_zh: 我不会背着她答应你。我们各自跟她说清楚。
choices.label_en: I won't promise you anything behind her back. We'll each speak to her ourselves.
choices.description_zh: 继续三人讨论；尚未提交双恋。
choices.description_en: Continue the three-way discussion; nothing is committed yet.

choices.label_zh: 我很在意你。让我先把话理清楚。
choices.label_en: I care about you. Let me sort out what to say first.

choices.label_zh: 你连告白都挑最短的说？
choices.label_en: You picked the shortest possible confession?

scenes.title_en: She Wants to Hear It From You

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 莉迪亚说，她喜欢我。我也喜欢她。我不想骗你说只把她当朋友，这件事得我自己告诉你。
lines.en: Lydia says she likes me. I like her too. I don't want to lie and say she's just a friend. I had to tell you myself.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 然后呢？你还真敢当着我的面说！
lines.en: ...And then? You really dare say it to my face!

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 我生气！我早就觉得不对劲了。她不来，你也不提。我还以为是我自己多心。
lines.en: Of course I'm angry! ...I've felt something was off for a while. She didn't come, and you didn't mention her. I thought I was imagining things.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 我一问起她，你就岔开话——你也知道早该说！
lines.en: Whenever I asked about her, you changed the subject. You knew you should have told me earlier!

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 那你现在想怎么样？跟我分开？
lines.en: So what do you want now? To break up with me?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 我想跟你在一起。可也喜欢上了她。这两句话，我都得当面说。
lines.en: I want to be with you. And I have fallen for her too. I owe you both truths, to your face.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 你倒是坦白。她呢？她怎么说？
lines.en: ...You're honest, at least. What about her? What did she say?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 她说会自己去找你。
lines.en: She said she'd come find you herself.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 她找我？
lines.en: She'll find me?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 前两天我还在想，她要是再也不来了，是不是就能当作什么都没发生。我自己想去找她。想问她到底在躲什么……又怕她真说出来。
lines.en: A couple of days ago I was still thinking that if she never came again, maybe I could pretend none of it happened. Then I wanted to go find her myself. To ask what she was hiding... and afraid she'd actually tell me.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 三个人吃饭，她拿块面包学别人挑货，我笑得差点把水洒了。她回来拿披肩，我还想叫她坐下。
lines.en: At dinner she held up that bread and imitated a customer. I nearly spilled my water laughing. When she came back for her shawl, I wanted to ask her to sit down again.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 我也想过，往后还这样一起过晚上。我想要你，也想她留下。……可你别以为，我这就不吃醋了。
lines.en: I have imagined more evenings together like that. I want you, and I want her to stay too. ...Do not think that means I have stopped being jealous.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 等你们谈过，我还在这儿。
lines.en: After you two talk, I'll still be here.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 先让我跟她谈。我有话要问她，你替不了。
lines.en: Let me talk to her first. I have questions for her that you can't answer for me.

blocks.label_en: One: Wait for Them to Talk

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 这几天你别突然不找我。别以为我生气了，你就该躲远点。
lines.en: Don't suddenly stop coming to see me these next few days. Don't think that because I'm angry, you should stay away.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 明天照常开门。你来，就能见到我。
lines.en: I'll open as usual tomorrow. If you come, you'll see me.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 哼。
lines.en: ...Hmph.

choices.label_zh: 好。等你们谈完。你想问我什么，我都答。
choices.label_en: All right. After you two talk. Whatever you want to ask me, I'll answer.
choices.description_zh: 继续共同关系讨论，尚未登记双恋。
choices.description_en: Continue the joint discussion; the relationship is not registered yet.

choices.label_zh: 我会把答应你们的事做到。
choices.label_en: I will keep my promises to both of you.
choices.description_zh: 明确承担这段关系，继续三方讨论。
choices.description_en: Take responsibility and continue the three-way discussion.

scenes.title_zh: 你教我的话，自己也听一遍
scenes.title_en: Listen to the Line You Taught Me

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 我去找她了。……不对，是她先来找的我。
lines.en: I went to find her. ...No, she came to find me first.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 她一进门就问：“你不是说过，喜欢一个人就别总让他猜吗？”那是我教她的话！她拿来堵我的嘴。
lines.en: The moment she walked in she asked, 'Didn't you say if you like someone, don't make them guess?' That's what I taught her! She used it to shut me up.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 我说那是说她。她说：“轮到你，就不算数了？”
lines.en: I said that was about her. She said: 'So it doesn't count when it's your turn?'

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 我说，她要是不想再看见我，我以后就不……话没说完，她就打断我：“你看，又替我把话答了。”
lines.en: I said if she didn't want to see me again, I just wouldn't—before I finished, she cut in: 'See? Answering for me again.'

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 以前看你们死活不肯开口，我恨不得替你们说。轮到自己，连第一句该从哪儿说起都不知道。
lines.en: I used to watch you two refuse to open your mouths and want to say it for you. Now it's my turn, and I don't even know where to start.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 她问我到底想要什么。我说，我想见你。不是把你送到门口，自己站在外面等。
lines.en: Then she asked what I actually wanted. I said I wanted to see you. Not to walk you to the door and stand outside waiting.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 她说，她也想我们三个还像那天，说着话就忘了时间。她不会一下子就不介意，也不会每回都把约好的晚上让给我。
lines.en: She said she wants the three of us to be like that day again, talking until we lose track of time. She won't stop minding all at once, and she won't give me every agreed evening either.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 我说那就各自约。一起去挑东西时，她得陪我逛完，别总惦记着回来见你。
lines.en: I said we'd make separate plans. When we go shopping together, she has to finish the trip with me. Don't keep thinking about coming back to see you.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 然后我们俩都哭了。……她不承认，你别问她。
lines.en: Then we both cried. ...She won't admit it. Don't ask her.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 她说下回跟我一起来。我连穿什么都想好了，话却还在脑子里打架。
lines.en: She said she'd come with me next time. I've already thought about what to wear, but the words are still fighting in my head.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 那我先说一句最要紧的。我想跟你在一起。
lines.en: Then I will say the most important bit first. I want to be with you.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 我也是。
lines.en: Me too.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 那下回就轮到你了。想清楚再说，别到时候只会一句“都行”。
lines.en: Then it'll be your turn next time. Think before you speak. Don't just sit there saying, 'Whatever you want.'

scenes.title_en: All Three of Us, Saying Everything

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 她跟你说我哭了，是吧？她先哭的。
lines.en: She told you I cried, didn't she? She cried first.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 手帕明明是我先拿出来的！……算了，今天不跟你争这个。
lines.en: I was the one who got out a handkerchief first! ...Oh, never mind. We can argue about that later.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 我想好了。我们三个一起试试。先说好，我吃醋会直接告诉你，别指望我突然变大方。
lines.en: I have thought it over. I want to try this, the three of us. And I will tell you when I am jealous. Do not expect sudden generosity.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 你约我的时候，也不许只顾着看她。
lines.en: And when you ask me out, you cannot spend the whole time looking at her.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 我愿意。……手给我。
lines.en: I want this. ...Give me your hand.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 我也愿意。这回别把我落在门口了。
lines.en: I'm willing too. This time don't leave me at the door.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 我本来只是来帮个小忙的。
lines.en: I only came to help out a little.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 帮得可真够彻底。
lines.en: You certainly helped thoroughly.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 那我要收介绍费。一个吻……别当着整家店的面。
lines.en: Then I'm charging a referral fee. One kiss... not in front of the whole shop.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 你就不能慢一点？
lines.en: Can't you slow down?

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 这个嘛，以后你可以教我。
lines.en: Well, you can teach me that later.

choices.label_zh: 如果你们也都愿意，那从今天起，我们三个人认真走下去。
choices.label_en: If you're both willing too, then starting today, let's be serious about this—all three of us.
choices.description_zh: 双方明确同意后提交双恋；不收取任何费用。
choices.description_en: Commit the dual relationship after both explicit agreements; no fee.

scenes.title_en: She Finally Doesn't Need an Excuse

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 忙完没有？我挑了半天衣服，你就看这一眼？
lines.en: Finished yet? I spent ages choosing what to wear, and that is all the attention I get?

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 今天想让我陪你多久？
lines.en: ...How long do you want me to stay today?

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 我想你了。
lines.en: I missed you.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 今天要去哪儿？已经到了。
lines.en: Where are we going today? We're already here.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 嗯，专门为这儿挑的。先挑了一条，太像去见长辈；换了这条，又舍不得那条的颜色，在镜子前转了好几圈。
lines.en: Mm. I picked it for this place. I tried one on first, but it looked too much like meeting a relative. Then I changed to this one and couldn't give up the color of the other. I turned in front of the mirror for ages.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 挑得很好。现在不用教了。
lines.en: You chose well. You don't need lessons now.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 以前教你夸她，没觉得一句话这么难接。……那你多看一会儿，又不是只给你看进门那一眼。
lines.en: When I was teaching you to compliment her, I never thought one sentence could be so hard to answer. ...Then look a little longer. It's not just for the glance at the door.

blocks.label_en: Replacement Middle Section Without the New Portrait

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 出门前照了好一会儿镜子。你再不说话，我可要自己夸了。
lines.en: I spent a long time in front of the mirror. If you say nothing, I shall have to compliment myself.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 看见了。今天很好看。
lines.en: I see. You look beautiful today.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 我还以为得我提醒你呢。
lines.en: ...I thought I'd have to remind you.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 再亲一下。
lines.en: ...Kiss me again.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 原来真到了这时候，我也没那么会说话。
lines.en: ...So when it actually happens, I'm not that good with words after all.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 你还记得我替首饰店摆的展柜吗？老板又找我了，这回我想换个摆法。
lines.en: Do you remember the display I arranged for the jewelry shop? The owner came to me again. I want to try a different layout this time.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 你跟她也约好了，我知道。今天别老看时间，弄得我随时又要先走。
lines.en: You've made plans with her too. I know. Don't keep checking the time today and making me feel I'll have to leave first.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 今天的时间是你的。
lines.en: Today's time is yours.

choices.label_en: Come here. Let me hold you for a while.
Sit closer. Let's take our time talking today.

scenes.title_en: She Didn't Give Up Her Place

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 今天是我们约好的。我就想听你说一遍。
lines.en: Today is our agreed time. I just want to hear you say it once.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 工作顺。上面的人都知道我哪天要早走。我跟他们说了，是来见你，不用偷偷摸摸。
lines.en: Work's fine. Everyone upstairs knows which day I leave early. I told them I'm coming to see you - no sneaking around.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 上回是她来陪你的吧。我不问待到几点。有一点吃醋！你别笑，我就是想知道。
lines.en: ...Last time it was her turn to keep you company, right? I won't ask how long. I'm a little jealous! Don't laugh. I just want to know.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 你别一见我，就把跟她说过的话全交代一遍，听得我像个来查账的。
lines.en: Don't recite everything you said to her the moment you see me. It makes me feel like I'm here to audit the books.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 今天就想说一件事——我从上面回来，第一个想见的还是你。别以为多了一个人，我就会少要一点。
lines.en: I only want to say one thing today—when I come back from upstairs, the first person I want to see is still you. Don't think one more person means I'll ask for less.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 没打算让你少要。
lines.en: I wasn't planning to ask you to.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 那就抱紧一点。
lines.en: Then hold me tighter.

scenes.title_zh: 今天不用替我们腾地方
scenes.title_en: You Don't Have to Make Room for Us Today

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 今天你别再说“随便吃点”。
lines.en: Don't say 'let's just eat something' today.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 不商量好，总有人忙到最后，拿冷饭当晚饭。
lines.en: If we don't plan it, someone always ends up busy until the food's cold and calls it dinner.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 她说的是你，也是她自己。
lines.en: She means you, and herself too.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 你现在连我的话都替我补全了？
lines.en: Now you're finishing my sentences for me?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 你以前补得比我多。
lines.en: You used to finish mine more than I do yours.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 那我就先——
lines.en: Then I'll just—

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 坐下。今天不用替我们腾地方。
lines.en: Sit down. You don't have to make room for us today.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 我又没说要走。上回坐在这儿，到这时候，就该我找借口了。
lines.en: I didn't say I was leaving. It's just... last time I sat here, at this point I'd be finding an excuse.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 这回不用找。你那份也留着呢。
lines.en: You don't need one this time. Your portion is still here.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 那我不走了。点心还没吃呢。
lines.en: ...Then I won't go. We haven't had the pastries yet.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 这点心，不是专门给我们买的吧？
lines.en: This dessert wasn't bought especially for us, was it?

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 本来是。今天我也想吃。我本来就会直说，只有喜欢你这件事，练得久了一点。
lines.en: It was at first. Today I wanted some too. I'm usually direct. Only liking you took a little practice.

blocks.label_en: After Dinner, If the Plaque Is Still in the Showcase

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 牌子还摆着呢。生意怎么样，我早就说了，还得看你自己。
lines.en: The plaque is still up. Business, like I said, depends on you.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 那你今天来检查生意？
lines.en: So are you here to inspect the business today?

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 今天不查。我想见的人，两个都在。
lines.en: Not today. Both the people I wanted to see are here.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 都坐近一点。我可不想隔着桌子看你们。
lines.en: Both of you sit closer. I don't want to look at you across the table.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 说得好！往这边挪，我还给你留了点心。
lines.en: Gladly! Move this way. I saved you some dessert.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 你再挪，我这边都没地方了。
lines.en: Any closer and there will be no room left on my side.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 你还好意思说我？
lines.en: And you have the nerve to say that about me?

blocks.label_en: Plaque Not Displayed or Not Collected

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 给我也尝一口你的。她那份奶油比我的还多。
lines.en: Let me try yours too. Hers has even more cream than mine.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 挑了半天，还是惦记别人的。
lines.en: All that choosing, and you still want someone else's.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 你刚才还夹走他碗里的菜呢！
lines.en: You just took something from his bowl!

blocks.label_en: Daily 1: The Two of Them Together

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 帮我看看，这条披肩配裙子，还是上一条好？
lines.en: Help me choose. Does this shawl suit the dress, or was the other one better?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 你一路问了我三遍。
lines.en: You asked me three times on the way here.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 所以才来问他呀。来，先别看本子。
lines.en: That's why I'm asking him. Come on, don't look at the books first.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 这条。……你也换了？都好看，站近点。
lines.en: This one. ...You changed too? Both look good. Stand closer.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 嗯。站近点就站近点。
lines.en: Mm. Closer it is.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 今晚席上又有人夸你了，说买回去的旧摆钟，比她家那座新钟还准。
lines.en: Someone praised you at dinner tonight. She said the old clock she bought here kept better time than her new one.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 你是不是又想问，我有没有说是我先找着这家店的？我忙着高兴，哪还记得！
lines.en: Are you going to ask again whether I told people I found this shop first? I was too busy being happy to remember!

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 那多陪我一会儿。也算替我庆祝。
lines.en: Then stay with me a little longer. Call it celebrating for me.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 好啊。先给你看看，我今天戴的这只耳夹。
lines.en: Gladly. But first, have a look at these earrings.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 看都看了，顺便把你这儿新收的也拿出来。耳夹总要配件东西。
lines.en: Since I've shown you mine, bring out what you've taken in lately. An ear clip needs something to go with it.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 自己挑。价钱照算。
lines.en: Pick something. The price is the price.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 她让我带句话，说她晚点再来。
lines.en: She asked me to tell you she'll come later.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 现在这会儿，是我的。后半句是我说的，不许删。
lines.en: Right now is mine. The second half was my addition. Don't cut it.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 明天我们俩出去，你自己记得吃饭。
lines.en: The two of us are going out tomorrow. Remember to eat.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 上回是谁嫌我们挑东西挑太久？这回不带你了。
lines.en: Who complained last time that we took too long shopping? You're not coming this time.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 那带点好吃的回来。
lines.en: Then bring back something good to eat.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 这个好办！
lines.en: That's easy!

scenes.title_en: In the Window and in the Shop

blocks.label_en: Daily 5: In the Window and in the Shop

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 刚才有人在外面盯着我的名字看。没看货，先问我是不是本人。
lines.en: Someone outside was staring at my name earlier. They didn't look at the goods. First they asked whether I was really me.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 你怎么说？
lines.en: What did you say?

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 我说是，然后让他看货，别光盯着我看。
lines.en: I said yes, then told him to look at the goods, not just at me.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 越来越会做生意了。
lines.en: You're getting better at business.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 那我坐会儿，你忙你的——这只耳夹，我都戴一路了，你还没看见？
lines.en: Then I'll sit a while. You do your work—but I've been wearing this ear clip the whole way here. You haven't noticed?

blocks.label_en: Daily 6: The Reason to Come Back

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 她在上面讲你这儿的东西，讲得比讲自己新买的裙子还多。
lines.en: Upstairs, she talks about the things in your shop more than she talks about the new dresses she buys.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 那是因为有人问！
lines.en: That's because people ask!

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 没人问的时候呢？
lines.en: And when no one asks?

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 也讲一点。你还不是一样，说是下来卖东西，坐下就不想走。
lines.en: ...I still talk about them a little. You're the same—you say you're coming down to sell goods, then you sit down and don't want to leave.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 今天都不急。
lines.en: No rush today.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 知道。别的事我都办完了。
lines.en: I know. I've finished everything else.

blocks.label_zh: 日常七：一件东西，两种意见

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 这摆件的颜色，也太热闹了吧？金漆还配红花。
lines.en: Those colors are rather lively, are they not? Gold paint and red flowers!

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 放在货里一眼就看得见，说不定好卖。
lines.en: It catches your eye among the stock. It might sell well.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 好卖就得夸好看？这句我可说不出口。
lines.en: Must I call it pretty because it sells? I refuse.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 那你说摆在哪儿。你上回那个展柜，我可听人夸过。
lines.en: Then tell me where to put it. I heard good things about your last display.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 还真比挤在一堆里顺眼。
lines.en: It does look better than when it was crammed in with everything else.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 东西俗一点，摆得可不能也俗。
lines.en: Of course! A gaudy ornament does not need a gaudy display.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 你们两个的事，我听她说过了，不是来让你重说一遍的。
lines.en: I've heard about you two from her. I'm not here to make you repeat it.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 有件事，我想亲口问你。
lines.en: But there's one thing I want to ask you myself.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 她们听我提了几回，都说愿意来看看，还让我带路。我说我亲自看过货，眼光总信得过。她们这才肯往下面走一趟。
lines.en: They heard me mention you a few times and said they'd like to come see the place. They even asked me to show them the way. I said I'd inspected the goods myself, so my judgment should be worth trusting. That's what got them to come down.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 摆橱窗里，别压在本子底下。认识我的人看见，就知道没走错门。
lines.en: Put it in the display window, not under the books. Anyone who knows me will see it and know they came to the right place.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 客人进来以后，看你的本事。我可没答应替你卖。
lines.en: Once customers are inside, that's your part. I never promised to sell for you.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 上回聚会，她们反过来夸你，说你挑旧货的眼光比上面几家店都准。我差点抢着说，是我先找着你的。
lines.en: At the last gathering they praised you back, saying your eye for old goods is sharper than several shops upstairs. I almost blurted out that I found you first.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 先收这个。她们再来挑东西，可就不只带零钱。以前总是我说你好，现在倒轮到我坐在那儿听。……还挺高兴的。
lines.en: Take this first. Next time they come shopping, they won't just bring pocket money. I used to be the one telling them you were good. Now I'm the one sitting there listening. ...I'm happy about it.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 今天竟有人托我，问能不能替她约你看货。以前都是我拉着她们来，现在得先问你哪天有空。
lines.en: Today someone actually asked me to arrange a viewing with you for her. Before, I was the one dragging them here. Now I have to ask which day you're free.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 你要来，我总会留时间。
lines.en: There is always time for you.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 我说的是客人。这个也给你，摆橱窗里。碰上满意的客人，她们也愿意多留谢意。
lines.en: ...I mean for customers. This one's for you too. Put it in the display. Satisfied customers are more willing to leave a token of thanks.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 真好。以后不用绞尽脑汁，想该带谁来捧场了。
lines.en: Good. No more racking my brain over who to bring to fill the place.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 上回替你收着的东西，我带来了。看看这次放得下没有。
lines.en: I brought what I was keeping for you. See if you have room this time.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 牌子摆不摆，你自己决定。我可没打算天天站门口数客人。
lines.en: Whether you put that plaque out is up to you. I am not standing outside counting customers every day.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 今天不查数——我有件自己的事。
lines.en: I'm not here to check the numbers today. I have something of my own.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 快告诉我，上回那顿饭，吃得怎么样？
lines.en: Tell me—how did the rest of that dinner go?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 工作的事还是照先前说的办。别每回见我，都像我要重新去应聘一样。
lines.en: Work is going as we discussed. You do not have to look at me as if I am applying all over again.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 先前没说清的那件事，今天说清吧。我不想再让我们两个猜了。
lines.en: Let us settle what we left unsaid. I do not want either of us to keep guessing.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 今天真是路过。我在隔壁看了一枚胸针，标价倒比东西还精神。
lines.en: I really was passing by today. I saw a brooch next door with a price rather more impressive than the brooch.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 来问你：石头松了，修好以后值不值得买？
lines.en: I came to ask you: the stone's loose. Is it worth buying after repairs?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 先算修理的钱。喜欢也别替卖家付两遍。
lines.en: Count the repair cost first. Liking it is no reason to pay the seller twice.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 这话能听。那我先不急着买了。
lines.en: That makes sense. Then I won't rush to buy it.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 埃莉诺问，你最近是不是又忙得没吃午饭。
lines.en: Eleanor wants to know whether you have been too busy to eat lunch again.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 她自己也忙，才让我跑这趟。你以为替你们传话不用走路？
lines.en: She's busy too. That's why she sent me. You think walking over to pass messages is free?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 替我跟她说，我吃过了。
lines.en: Tell her I have eaten.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 真吃过再说。她下回问我你吃的什么，我可编不出来。
lines.en: Tell me that after you've actually eaten. If she asks what you had next time, I can't make it up.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 我妈今天又问起你。问你店里忙不忙，饭有没有按时吃。她现在倒替你操起心来了。
lines.en: My mother asked about you again today. Whether the shop's busy, whether you're eating on time. Now she's worrying about you.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 我说我自己来看看。……你先忙，我又没说非要你陪我。
lines.en: I said I'd come and see for myself. ...Go on with your work. I never said you had to entertain me.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 你们约饭别再挑她工作最忙的时候。她嘴上不说，回去连鞋都懒得脱。
lines.en: Don't schedule meals when she's busiest at work. She won't say it, but she goes home too tired to take off her shoes.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 不是替她管你。下回先问她。也别拿最贵的店证明你记住了，找个能坐着吃完的地方。
lines.en: I'm not managing you for her. Next time ask her first. And don't prove you remembered by picking the most expensive place. Find somewhere you can sit and finish the meal.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 记住就行。
lines.en: Just remember that.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 这件首饰，我最后还是没买。试了三次，每次都想问别人好不好看。一想，我自己都没那么喜欢。
lines.en: I didn't buy that piece in the end. I tried it three times, and every time I wanted to ask someone whether it looked good. Then I thought, I didn't even like it that much.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 这回没替谁挑。我自己的东西，总得让我自己点头。
lines.en: This time I didn't pick it for anyone else. My own things have to get my own approval.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 埃莉诺说，店里这阵子还不错。
lines.en: Eleanor says business has been decent lately.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 那你先忙。我今天没有要你当场回答的问题。
lines.en: Then carry on. I have no question you need to answer on the spot today.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 坐一会儿也行。
lines.en: You can sit for a while.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 那就一会儿。别以为我要替你看店。
lines.en: ...Just a little while. Do not expect me to watch the shop.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 窗口边先响了一声，接着又是第二下。莉迪亚那下没敲完，埃莉诺的手就覆了上去。
lines.en: Lydia taps twice on the window frame. Eleanor catches her hand on the second tap.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 早！今天我们俩谁也没赖床。
lines.en: Morning! We both managed to get up today.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 够早。旧货还没分。
lines.en: Early. The old stock isn't sorted yet.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 正好。来之前就说要弄那一层，没打算忘。
lines.en: Perfect. I said I'd help you sort that shelf today—I didn't forget.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: （放下外套，从上层取了两件旧衣）最下格别碰。你上次排的那堆，我还没琢磨明白。
lines.en: (Sets down her coat and takes two old garments off the top shelf) Leave the bottom cubby alone. I still can't make sense of how you arranged them last time.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 她对你讲话都这么冲？……也是，她好像对谁都这样。
lines.en: She talks to you like that now—so sure of herself? ...No, wait. She's always been like that with everyone.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: （隔着窗子指了指）那只铜表还在呀。我带了块擦镜子的布。
lines.en: (She points through the window.) That brass watch is still here. I've got a cloth for polishing mirrors.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 怀表。别上手。
lines.en: A pocket watch. Don't wipe it.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 留着灰多可惜，铜壳子擦亮了才好看吧？
lines.en: Why? It'd look nice cleaned up. It's brass, right?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 矿上的人押的。灰是井下带上来的。
lines.en: A miner pawned it. He brought the dust up from the mine.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 他来押表那天留了话。灰没了，表就不是他的了。
lines.en: When he pawned it, he told me—wipe off the dust, and it's not his watch anymore.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 我回头得说给她们听。下面的人连块表都得送进当铺，谁听了不难受？
lines.en: I'm definitely telling the girls about this when I get back. People down below have to pawn even a watch—who wouldn't feel sorry for them?

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 这样，钱我出，把表赎了送还他。留个名，就写“一位朋友”。
lines.en: Maybe I could pay to redeem it and have someone send it back? Sign it 'A friend.'

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 还落款？
lines.en: You're signing it, too?

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 人叫什么，住哪层，你一概不知，留名倒先想好了。
lines.en: You don't know his name or what floor he lives on—not one thing—but you've already got the signature figured out.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: ……我就顺嘴一提。
lines.en: ...I was just saying it offhand.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: （把台面旧衣拢成一堆推进窗）这下面的人，不缺你顺嘴一提。
lines.en: (Sorts the old clothes on the counter into a pile and hands them through the window) People down here don't need your offhand remarks.

blocks.label_en: The Pocket Watch — Put the watch away

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: （把怀表重新搁进玻璃格）这故事不往下说。
lines.en: (Puts the pocket watch back in the cubby) Not this one.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 怎么这样，说半截最让人睡不着。
lines.en: Aw, stingy. Stopping halfway is the worst.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: ……那我理这筐。你看着点，别一会儿又叫我全倒出来。
lines.en: …I'll sort this basket, then. Keep an eye on me. I don't want to empty it out twice.

blocks.label_en: The Pocket Watch — Let her ask

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 你问。
lines.en: Go on. Ask.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 我自己问？那……押表的人还来赎吗？
lines.en: Ask for myself? Well… is he coming back for his watch?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 他没准备赎。
lines.en: He never meant to redeem it.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 不赎？那当初押它做什么？
lines.en: Never meant to? Then why pawn it?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 那一个月井上停工。换到的钱，够他家撑到复工。
lines.en: The mine shut down that month. The pawn money fed his family till it reopened.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 后来上工了，他每月来一回，只看这表一阵，不赎。
lines.en: After it reopened, he came once a month. One look, then left. Never redeemed it.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 每月都来……只为看它一眼？
lines.en: Every month... just to look?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 就站在这儿，问灰还在不在。我说在，他转身就走。
lines.en: Stood a while, asked if the ash was still there. I said yes. He left.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: （手里正理的衣服停了）这段你从没告诉过我。
lines.en: (her hands stop on the clothes) You never told me that.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 你也没问。
lines.en: You never asked.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 哼，那我问一句。之后还来过吗？
lines.en: Hmph. Then I'm asking now. Does he still come?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 去年冬天过后，再没来过。
lines.en: Not since last winter.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: （手从胸前滑下）……你就一直收着它。
lines.en: (lowers her hand from her chest) Then... you've kept it all this time.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 押单没到期。日子没到，这表就还是他的。
lines.en: The ticket's not due yet. Until then, it's his.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: （把脚边的旧货筐往她那边推了推）别绕。这筐归你，理完告诉我。
lines.en: Cut it. Get to work. That basket of junk is yours.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 莉迪亚挽起袖口，腕上的镯子滑到腕骨处。
lines.en: Lydia rolls up her sleeves. The bracelet slides down to her wrist bone.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 好。每样放哪儿你说明白，我可不想再被你训一回。
lines.en: Fine. You need to tell me exactly what goes where. I don't want you scolding me again.

choices.description_zh: 顺着莉迪亚的好奇，把怀表主人的事讲完。
choices.description_en: Follow Lydia's curiosity and finish the story of the watch's owner.

choices.description_zh: 不把别人的旧事当故事讲。
choices.description_en: Don't tell someone else's old story.

choices.description_zh: 让莉迪亚自己开口问押表的事。
choices.description_en: Let Lydia ask about the pledged watch herself.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 理货时清出来的旧血袋搁在柜台角上，管口还缠着线。
lines.en: An old blood bag found while sorting stock sits in a corner of the counter, its tube tied off with string.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 我们回来了。今天这顿她请的，你信吗？我钱包都掏出来了，她一把把我手按回去。
lines.en: We're back! She paid for lunch today, can you believe it? I tried to pay and she pinned my hand down.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 就配给站边上那家。明明两个人吃，她数出三份的钱。
lines.en: The one by the ration station. Two people eating, and she wanted to pay for three.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 我当是给小费！……好，她说这边不兴这个。
lines.en: That was a tip! ...Fine, she says they don't do that down below.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 对了，我下午还得去……唉，去另一边。你俩先待着，我晚点再回来。
lines.en: Oh, right, I still have to go this afternoon... uh, go over there. You two talk, I'll be back later.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 另一边？你说清楚，到底是哪儿。
lines.en: Over where?

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 就是另一边。你们好不容易凑一块儿，窗口又没客人——
lines.en: Just over there. You're both finally free, and there are no other customers at the window—

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 莉迪亚。
lines.en: Lydia.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: （把柜上的血袋朝自己这侧拨了半寸）你走了，谁来帮我理这堆？
lines.en: (She shifts the blood bag a little closer.) Who's helping me sort this lot if you go?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 想走就走。不走就过来，先帮我看这袋东西。
lines.en: Go if you're going. If not, come here and look at this.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: （凑近柜台，低下头）这是……装血的袋子？里面是空的？
lines.en: (Leans in close) This is... a blood bag? It's empty, right?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 空的。你数数封口边上那排印子。
lines.en: Empty. Count the marks along the edge.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 一、二、三……这么多道？是拿来记账的吗？
lines.en: One, two, three... that many? What's this for, keeping count?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 有个女人押在这儿的。她每次去卖一回血，就在袋子边划一道。
lines.en: A woman pawned it. Every time she sold blood, she cut a mark on the edge.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 卖血……我还当那种事早没人干了。
lines.en: Selling blood... I thought that only happened in old stories.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: （把袋口松开的线头按了按）配给站后头就有。天没亮，那边排队的人比领饭的还早。
lines.en: They've got them right behind the ration station. People line up earlier in the morning for those than for food.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 她划这些做什么？
lines.en: What were the marks for?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 怕自己记岔。抽得太勤，人会直接倒在队里。
lines.en: Afraid she'll lose count. Draw too often, you pass out in line.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 她说，这一边一划满，孩子的药钱也就够了。
lines.en: She said once this side is filled, she'll have enough for the kid's medicine.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: （指尖落在最后一道刻痕上）这一边……还没满。
lines.en: (fingers stop on the last mark) This side... isn't full yet.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 差三道。
lines.en: Three marks short.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 差三道，她干吗还拿出来押？
lines.en: Three short, so why did she pawn it?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 她的事，就讲到这儿。
lines.en: That's enough about her.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 你这不是成心急人……行，我不问了。
lines.en: You're going to drive me crazy... Fine, I won't ask.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: （把血袋推回柜台正中）那我留下来理货。给我腾个地儿。
lines.en: (She slides the bag back to the middle.) I'll stay and sort. Make room for me.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 孩子病好了，这袋子用不上了。
lines.en: The kid's better. She doesn't need it anymore.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 她说要再留家里，夜里会忍不住继续数。押出来，就由不得她去看了。
lines.en: She said if she kept it, she'd end up counting at night. Pawn it, and she won't have to look at it.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: ……病好了？
lines.en: ...Better?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 好了。上星期还来这儿买过东西。
lines.en: Better. She even came in last week to buy something.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 我刚才一直在等你讲，说人没了。
lines.en: I was waiting for you to say she died.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 嗯。（把血袋推回柜台中央）那我不走了。
lines.en: Mm. (pushes the blood bag back to the middle of the counter) Then I'm not leaving.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 你刚不是还要往另一边跑？
lines.en: Weren't you going over there just now?

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 另一边没了，我编的。这总行了吧？
lines.en: There is no over there. I made it up. Happy now?

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 哼。
lines.en: Hmph.

choices.description_zh: 告诉她血袋后来怎么了。
choices.description_en: Tell her what happened to the blood bag.
Leave the ending on this side of the counter.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 打烊前，矿石还搁在柜台角上，柜面被划出条灰道。
lines.en: Before closing, the ore sits by the scale pan, leaving a gray streak on the counter.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: （指尖在台面上碰了碰，没碰到矿石）这块呢？有来处吧？别一下讲完，我想慢慢听。
lines.en: (points at the ore) What about this? It has a story too, right? Don't tell it all at once. I want to hear it slow.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 矿工家的女儿送来的。她爹在井下起出的头一块。
lines.en: A miner's daughter brought it in. The first one her dad dug out underground.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 头一块……就单独放到了今天？没拿去换钱？
lines.en: The first one... and she kept it? Didn't sell it?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 灰底下就那么一点矿，卖不上价。
lines.en: There's barely any ore under all that ash. It won't fetch much.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 她爹说，头一块不算活，算运气。
lines.en: Her dad said the first one isn't work. It's luck.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 那她送到这儿来做什么？
lines.en: Then why bring it here?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 她来上头做工，带不动，又不肯丢。
lines.en: She's going up top to work. Can't take it, doesn't want to throw it out.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 来上头……这边会有人把她当回事吗？
lines.en: Up top... will people there treat her right?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 说不好。
lines.en: Don't know.

blocks.label_en: The Ore — Tell her not to touch it

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 别动。那东西是人家的。
lines.en: Don't touch it. Someone left it here.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: （手缩到窗边）好，我不动。
lines.en: (She draws her hand back.) All right. Eleanor, are you coming tomorrow? …Oh, ask him yourself.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 想拿就拿着。会沾一手灰。
lines.en: Go ahead. The dust gets on your hands.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: （双手托起来）压手得很，比我想的沉。
lines.en: (lifts it in both hands) So heavy. Heavier than I thought.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 她一路抱着下来，再放到你这台面上……
lines.en: She carried it all the way down, then stood at your counter holding it...

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: （搁回柜台角，看了看指腹）先不擦。
lines.en: (gently puts it back and looks at the dust on her fingertip) I'm not wiping it.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: （咬了一小口，嚼得很慢）……这味儿？你能连着吃好几个礼拜？
lines.en: (takes a bite and chews for a long time)…This is what it tastes like? You ate this for weeks?

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 不止。
lines.en: More than a few weeks.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 那我全吃完。剩不下。
lines.en: Then I'll finish it. Not one bite left.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 这钱收少了吧？别看见我挨着她坐就便宜。
lines.en: You undercharged me, didn't you? Don't cut the price because I'm her friend.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 收你的是打烊价。
lines.en: Closing price.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: ……我记下了，下回专挑贵的拿。
lines.en: …I'll remember that. Next time I'll pick something expensive.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 呵，倒会给自己记上了。
lines.en: Heh. She's learning to keep accounts too.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 比她讲的多收了？
lines.en: Is it a little more than she said?

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 多了。谁让你穿这身。
lines.en: More. He saw you dressed nice today.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 那我服。下回换旧的来。
lines.en: Then I'll take it. Next time I'll wear something old.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 怎么，不卖我？
lines.en: Huh? You won't sell to me?

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 他该关门了。要吃明天再来。
lines.en: He's closing up. If you want some, come back tomorrow.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 明天我早来，跟你当初一样，自己上手。
lines.en: Then I'll come early tomorrow. Pick it myself, like you did.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: （隔着窗朝货架扬了扬下巴）你刚来时吃的是哪个？最便宜的那款？
lines.en: (Looks through the window at the shelves) Which kind did you eat when you first got here? The cheapest one?

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 你咽不下去。
lines.en: You won't like it.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 咽不下去也吃完。我只买我这份，不给你带。
lines.en: I'll finish it even if I don't like it. I'm only buying mine. Not for you.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: （把窗口前那一小块台面抹干净）随你。别咽到半道又找我要水。
lines.en: (lifts her chin) Fine. Don't come running to me for water halfway through.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: （把吃的推到柜台中间）老板，照她早先的价。我就在这儿吃，不带走。
lines.en: (sets the basic food on the counter) Boss, same price as she paid back then. I'll eat it here. No takeout.

choices.description_zh: 让她亲手掂一掂那块矿石。
choices.description_en: Let her feel the ore for herself.

choices.label_en: Tell her not to touch it
choices.description_en: Don't touch collateral someone else left.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 那人绕开货架，径直走到窗边，一只手按在柜面上。
lines.en: The visitor ignores the shelves, comes to the window, and plants his hand on the counter.

lines.speaker: Thug
lines.text: 你这儿最近老有两个上面来的女人进吧？
lines.en: Two uptown girls been coming around here lately?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 买货还是当东西？
lines.en: Buying?

lines.speaker: Thug
lines.text: 我买句话。找个头发亮、腕子上套镯子的。
lines.en: Buying a word. One with shiny hair, a bracelet on her wrist.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 我店里没这话卖。
lines.en: We don't sell words here.

lines.speaker: Thug
lines.text: （指尖敲了敲玻璃格）先别急着轰人。那镯子，上个月差点就换主了。
lines.en: (Fingers tapping the glass case) Don't rush me out. That bracelet almost changed hands last month.

lines.speaker: Thug
lines.text: 出钱的那位回来以后，心里一直堵着。
lines.en: The one who made the offer went home unhappy. Still is.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 东西是人家的。人自己赎走了。
lines.en: It's hers. She bought it back.

lines.speaker: Thug
lines.text: 所以今天我来问人，不碰东西。
lines.en: That's why I'm asking about the girl today. Not the thing.

lines.speaker: Thug
lines.text: 上头来的人，家里都出得起钱接回去。你不认这理？
lines.en: An uptown girl — someone in her family always pays to get her back. Right?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 没听懂你在问什么。
lines.en: Don't follow.

lines.speaker: Thug
lines.text: 装。（从柜台角拿起那块矿石，上下抛了抛）这烂石头也配在柜上摆着？
lines.en: Playing dumb. (Picks up the ore by the scale and weighs it) You keep this junk on the counter?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 当押的。放回去。
lines.en: That's collateral. Put it down.

lines.speaker: Thug
lines.text: 这也能押？（没松开，翻过来瞧底面）灰积得可不少。
lines.en: Collateral? This? (Doesn't put it down, turns it over to see the bottom) Plenty of dust.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 没见着什么女人。
lines.en: Haven't seen any girls.

lines.speaker: Thug
lines.text: 巷口到巷尾都有人瞧见她俩钻你这儿，偏你说没看见？
lines.en: The whole alley sees them coming here. You're the only one with bad eyesight?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 看见也认不准。
lines.en: Can't see straight. Must've been wrong.

lines.speaker: Thug
lines.text: 那改天我找个认人准的来。
lines.en: Then next time I'll bring someone who can.

blocks.label_en: Asking Directions — Ask who sent him

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 谁支你来的？
lines.en: Who sent you?

lines.speaker: Thug
lines.text: 上月没谈成的那位。叫我来看看你这店铺经不经摔。
lines.en: The one the deal fell through with last month. He sent me to see how sturdy this shop is.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 看过了？
lines.en: Seen enough?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 把石头搁下。掉头，出去。
lines.en: Put it down. Turn around and go.

lines.speaker: Thug
lines.text: （把矿石往柜台角一扔）火气不小。
lines.en: (tosses the ore back by the scale) Got a temper on you.

lines.speaker: Thug
lines.text: 来问你已经算给你台阶。你少掺和那两人，后头的事沾不着你。
lines.en: I'm doing you a favor by asking. Stop looking out for those two and what happens next has nothing to do with you.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 进了店就是我的客。谁来我也不往外撵。
lines.en: They're my customers. I don't turn them away.

lines.speaker: Thug
lines.text: 你窗上这玻璃，经不起两下。
lines.en: That glass of yours is pretty thin.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 碎了我也能自己换。
lines.en: It's thin. It breaks, I replace it.

lines.speaker: Thug
lines.text: （退了两步，扭头扫过那排玻璃格）你那表太招眼，摆那么前头。
lines.en: (Steps back and glances at the glass display) That watch of yours stands out.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: （他抬手在窗框上一敲），响动顺着巷子散了。
lines.en: He knocks on the window frame as he leaves, the sound carrying down the alley.

choices.description_en: Don't admit the two girls were here.

choices.label_en: Make him drop it and go
choices.description_zh: 把矿石要回来，把人请出去。
choices.description_en: Get the ore back. Show him out.
Find out who's behind it first.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 到了。今天配给站前头没排长队，你敢信？
lines.en: We're here! There wasn't even a line at the ration station today, can you believe it—

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 先别顾着高兴，看他的脸。
lines.en: Look at his face first.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 脸？怎么了……（声音低下来）出什么事了？
lines.en: His face? What's wrong...(quieter) Did something happen?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 中午来了个人，打听你。
lines.en: Someone came by at noon. Asking about you.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 打听我？问的什么？
lines.en: Asking about me? Asking what?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 问你今天几点来，走哪条路，还提了你腕上那只镯子。
lines.en: What time you come in. Which route. And that bracelet on your wrist.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 上回没买成的那个，说咽不下这口气。
lines.en: The one whose bid fell through last time. Says he's unhappy.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: （右手抓紧左腕）就为那点事？这都过去多久了！
lines.en: (Claps her right hand over her left wrist) For that? That was ages ago!

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 他是不是还说了别的？
lines.en: What else did he say?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 说上边来的姑娘，家里愿意出钱带人走。
lines.en: The girl from up top. Her family'll pay to get her back.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 这是打算绑了人，管家里要钱。
lines.en: Hah. So he wants to snatch someone for money.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 绑人？他指的只有我，还是我们两个都算？
lines.en: Snatch... no, wait. Did he mean me, or both of us?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 他光说是上边的。
lines.en: He only said from up top.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 那就一块儿算上。在他眼里我也是上面下来的，他又不会去翻册子。
lines.en: Then it's both. To him I'm from up top too. He doesn't check papers.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: （把镯子往下撸）那我把这个给他们行不行？东西拿走，别再来烦你们——
lines.en: (Starts pulling the bracelet off) Then I'll just give it to them, okay? Let them take it and leave you alone—

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 别摘。
lines.en: Keep it on.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 他说的是人，不是镯子。
lines.en: He said he's asking about the person. Not the thing.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: （手停在半截，镯子没摘下来）那怎么办？我现在就去治安部。
lines.en: (Her hand stops, the bracelet stuck halfway)... Then what? I'll go to the Watch. I'll go right now.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 你去能说什么？有人到窗口问了你几句？
lines.en: What would we report? Someone coming to the window and asking a few questions?

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 下边治安部的人，没见着谁倒地上，连笔都懒得拿。
lines.en: The Watch down here? Unless someone's lying on the ground, they won't even open the book.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 那我偏要他们查。我报出家里的姓，他们总得抬起头来。
lines.en: Then I'll make them open it! I'll give my family name. They'll at least look up.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 这倒也不是不行。
lines.en: ...That might work.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 看吧，我多少还顶点用。
lines.en: See? I'm not completely useless.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 先别急着去。那人长什么样，你记得住吗？
lines.en: Drop it. Before you go, describe what he looked like. You remember?

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 我又没见过。老板，他长什么模样？
lines.en: I missed him again! Boss, what does he look like?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 左耳缺了一块，手背有疤。他还翻过我那些矿石。
lines.en: Chunk missing from his left ear. Scar on the back of his hand. And he touched my ore.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: （手指点着数）左耳缺一块，疤在手背……等等，他把你的矿石拿走了？
lines.en: (Counting on her fingers) Left ear, back of the hand, ore... did he take the ore?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 又放下了。
lines.en: Put it back.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 那倒还好。（刚缓过气又皱眉）不对，这算什么好。
lines.en: That's a relief. (Breathes out, then frowns) No, wait. Relief? What relief.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 埃莉诺，这两天你先别……
lines.en: Eleanor, for the next few days, don't…

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 我照样来。他爱怎么打听就怎么打听，我走我的路。
lines.en: I'll come as usual. He can ask his way around. I'll walk mine.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 那我也来。你一个人走那条巷子，想都别想。
lines.en: Then I'll come as usual too. Don't think you're walking that alley alone.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 这一趟，是我陪着你，还是你陪着我？
lines.en: Hmph. Are you keeping me company, or am I keeping you?

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 都行，两个人走就成。
lines.en: Either way! It's two of us.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 天擦黑前动身，走配给站那半边，人多。
lines.en: Go before dark. Take the ration station side. More people.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: （把搁在旁边的矿石往柜台里侧拢了拢）你呢？他惦记这店，你一个人守着？
lines.en: (Glances at the ore by the scale) What about you? He came for your shop. You're guarding it alone?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 这店向来是我一个人看。
lines.en: I've always guarded it alone.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 这像什么话。
lines.en: Ridiculous.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: （把镯子套回腕上，袖口拉下来遮住）明天我先去治安部，回来跟你们说。
lines.en: (Pushes the bracelet back up her wrist and pulls her sleeve over it) Tomorrow I'll go to the Watch first, then come back and tell you.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 治安部的人在簿子上划了两行，说会留意。我瞧他们就是给我个说法，根本没打算管。
lines.en: The Watch wrote two lines and said they'd keep an eye out. Felt like they were brushing me off.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 能给你落两行字算给面儿了。（把最后那摞旧衣从窗口塞进去）齐了，别站这儿了。
lines.en: Two lines is something.(Hands the last pile of clothes through the window) All sorted. Let's go.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: （往外走了两步，又折回窗口）……别急。
lines.en: (Takes two steps away, then returns to the window)...Wait.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 巷子外头有三个人。中间那个，左耳少了半截。
lines.en: Three men at the alley mouth. The one in the middle—his left ear's missing a chunk.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: （走到窗口边。）
lines.en: Stay close to the window.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 配给站那边呢，你瞧了吗？
lines.en: What about the other end of the alley?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 往配给站那侧走，看脱不脱得了身。
lines.en: Toward the ration station. See if it's clear.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: （偏头朝那方向望了一眼）那面一样有人。
lines.en: (Looks the other way) There's someone there too.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 他们朝窗口来了，手里还举着东西！老板，当心！
lines.en: They're coming! They're smashing the window! Boss, watch out!

blocks.label_zh: 关门前：让她们走巷子另一头
blocks.label_en: Before Closing — The other end of the alley

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 配给站那面，现在就走，别磨蹭。
lines.en: Go toward the ration station. Quickly.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: （一把拽住莉迪亚退了几步，又定住）后巷有脚步声。
lines.en: (Pulls Lydia a few steps away, then stops) There are footsteps behind us in the alley too.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 前头后头都有人？那我哪儿也不躲了，就在这儿。
lines.en: Both ends blocked? Then I'm not going anywhere.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 贴着窗边站，别出声。
lines.en: Stay by the window. Keep quiet.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: （从窗口伸手攥住他的袖口）我不说话，你也不许硬扛……
lines.en: (Grips his sleeve through the window) I'll be quiet. Don't you go playing...

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 外头的人抓住卷帘猛往下扯，铁棍跟着抡起来，窗边那几格玻璃碎得到处都是。
lines.en: The man yanks down on the shutter, then swings an iron bar into the glass display beside the window.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 他冲的是那个戴镯子的人——我腕子上什么都没有！今天出门就没戴！
lines.en: He said the one with the bracelet—I'm not wearing one! I didn't wear one at all today!

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: （从窗口探出胳膊，架开那只抓向莉迪亚的手）货你随便拿，人别碰。
lines.en: (Reaches through the window to block his hand as it grabs for Lydia) Take the goods. You're not taking anyone.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 你少碰他！
lines.en: Don't touch him!

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 松开！你抓着我手腕了，撒手！
lines.en: Let go of me! Why are you grabbing my wrist—let go!

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: （另一只手摸到柜面那半瓶香水，朝他脸上一通按）你眼睛还睁得开吗！
lines.en: (Her other hand finds the half-empty perfume bottle on the counter; she aims it at the man's face and presses down) Can you still open your eyes!

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: （抄起柜上的扳手，照他胳膊肘敲下去）给我撒手！
lines.en: (Grabs the wrench from the counter and strikes his elbow) Let go!

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 老板，你还能站稳吗？
lines.en: Boss, can you stand?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 撑得住。快喊人。
lines.en: I can stand. Call for help.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: （朝巷子后头扬声）治安部的人到配给站了，就在转角！你们跑不跑？
lines.en: (Shouts down the alley) Security's at the ration station! Just around the corner!

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 那两个人架着他……退了！他们撤了！
lines.en: The other two are pulling him back... They're gone! They've gone!

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: （扳手还攥在手里）跑得倒快。
lines.en: (She still has the wrench in her hand.) Quick on their feet.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 哪有什么治安部，我瞎说的。
lines.en: Security never came. I made it up.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 你瞎编的？你胆子真……（笑得声音都抖）装得比我像多了。
lines.en: You made that up? How dare you...(Laughs, her voice shaking) You made it sound more real than I could.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: （扳手放到柜上，转身按住他肩）坐下。
lines.en: (puts down the wrench, turns to him) Sit down.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 你整条袖子都染红了……你别起身，我去翻干净的布。
lines.en: There's a big red patch on your sleeve... Don't move. I'll find a clean cloth.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: （伏到柜台那摞旧衣前，抖着手跟捆绳较劲）这些能撕吗？能吧？
lines.en: (Lunges for the pile of clothes on the counter, her hands shaking too hard to undo the cord) Can I tear this? I can, right?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 撕吧。
lines.en: Yes.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 撕那件灰的。价签别管了。
lines.en: Tear the gray one. Forget the price tag.

choices.description_en: Reach out to block the attacker.

choices.label_zh: 让她们从巷子另一头走
choices.label_en: Send them down the other end of the alley
choices.description_en: Get them out first.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 窗口卷帘已经放到底。店主左胳膊上裹着条旧布，打的结朝外偏着。
lines.en: The window shutter has been straightened. A strip of old cloth wraps the shopkeeper's arm, its knot crooked on the outside.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 这布谁给你裹的？
lines.en: Who tied the cloth round your arm?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 我。
lines.en: Me.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 一只手绕的，怪不得丑成这样。
lines.en: With one hand, right? No wonder it's so ugly.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: （拎着扫帚在窗口前站定）我昨晚又跑了趟治安部，这回他们写了满满一页。
lines.en: (Comes to the window carrying a broom) I went back to Security last night. This time they wrote a whole page.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 那人哪天来的、出了多少钱，我都说了。值班的抬头问我家里知不知道。
lines.en: I told them about the man who made the offer too. What day he came, how much he offered. The officer on duty was halfway through writing when he looked up and asked if my family knew about this.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 你怎么答的？
lines.en: What did you say?

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 我说，马上就会知道。（扫帚往地上一戳）他落笔飞快。
lines.en: I said they're about to. (stabs the broom into the floor) He wrote that down quick.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 呵。
lines.en: Hah.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 我原先最烦抬出家里的名头。可昨天那种阵势，让我搬什么都行。
lines.en: I always hated dragging my family's name into things... but after last night, I'd drag anything.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 你先坐下。胳膊搭出来，袖子往上挽。
lines.en: Sit down, put your arm through, and roll up your sleeve.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 我已经换过了。
lines.en: Changed it myself.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 看见了。再不动它，结就全散开了。
lines.en: I can see that. The knot's nearly come undone.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: （隔着窗托住他小臂，把旧布解下来）口子不深，昨天是血糊得多。
lines.en: (Supports his arm through the window and unwraps the old cloth) It's not deep. It looked frightening yesterday.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: （蹲在窗外碎玻璃边）玻璃格碎了三层。那堆旧货砸坏了一半。香水也让我喷没了。
lines.en: (Crouches beside the broken glass outside) Three shelves of the glass display are smashed. Half that pile of stock is ruined. And I used all the perfume.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 那香水是店里的货吧？我——
lines.en: That perfume was store stock, right? I—

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 用得对。
lines.en: Put to good use.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: ……你别这样讲，我真会掉眼泪。
lines.en: …Don't say that. I'll cry.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 玻璃我出钱。那些人是冲我来的，这扇玻璃算我惹的。
lines.en: Let me pay to replace the glass. Those men came for me. So that glass is basically my doing.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 玻璃我自己来。
lines.en: I'll replace the glass myself.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 果然，我就猜你会这么回。
lines.en: See, I knew you'd say that.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 扫地归你。扫干净。
lines.en: You sweep. Sweep it clean.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: （怔了下，笑出来）行。我扫到没人挑出毛病。
lines.en: (Blinks, then laughs) Fine. I'll sweep until you can't find a thing wrong.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: （从碎玻璃里拣起那块怀表）盖摔脱了，灰撒出来些。没擦，拿纸接住，又原样倒回盖里。
lines.en: (Picks the pocket watch out of the glass) The lid popped open. Some of the ash spilled out. I didn't wipe it—caught it on paper and poured it back in the lid.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 递进来，收抽屉里。
lines.en: Hand it to me. I'll put it in the drawer.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: （把怀表从窗口递过去）玻璃格也得换了吧？
lines.en: (Hands the watch through the window) The glass display needs replacing too, doesn't it?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 嗯。先收进柜台里边。
lines.en: Yes. I'll keep it behind the counter for now.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: （拿布蘸了点肥皂水，压在他伤口边上）疼就出声。
lines.en: (Dips the cloth in soapy water, presses it by the wound) Say if it hurts.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 不疼。
lines.en: Doesn't hurt.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 装什么，小臂都在颤。
lines.en: Cut it out. Your arm's shaking.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 昨天你往跟前一挡，我就想吼你。
lines.en: Yesterday, when you stepped forward, I wanted to yell at you.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 骂了。
lines.en: You did.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 事后才骂得出来。那会儿嘴里一个音都没有。
lines.en: That was later. In the moment I couldn't get a word out.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: （指头压着布，没拿开）下回别自己往前顶。我手边也有扳手。
lines.en: (Fingers pressing the cloth, not moving away) Next time, don't step up alone. I've got a wrench too.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 你砸得准。
lines.en: You hit square.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: ……谁要听你这个。
lines.en: …Who asked you that.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 她出手可准，那人当场叫出来。我那下香水也不差吧？
lines.en: She hit him square. He squealed like someone stepped on his foot. My perfume wasn't bad either, was it?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 你自己还不是喷完咳得停不下来。
lines.en: You were coughing after you sprayed it.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 那味道太冲了！哪家香水那样冲……（声音低下去）昨天我真怕他把我拽走。
lines.en: The smell was too strong! Who makes perfume that strong...(Her voice drops) Yesterday I really thought he was going to drag me away.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 没拽成。
lines.en: He didn't pull it off.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 对，没成。（接着扫）今天我也还戴着，哪儿都不掖。他们敢再来，治安部那张纸就再添几笔。
lines.en: Yeah, he didn't. (goes back to sweeping) I'm still wearing it today. Not hiding it anywhere. If they dare come back, that page at the Security Department gets a little thicker.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: （拿布条缠紧他胳膊，用力打了个结）好了。三天别碰重东西。
lines.en: (wraps the strip of cloth around his arm and ties it hard) There. No heavy lifting for three days.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 货得搬。
lines.en: Goods need moving.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 我搬。明天、后天都过来。
lines.en: I'll move them. I'll come tomorrow. And the day after.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: （把碎玻璃扫进簸箕）我也来。碎玻璃只能归我，别跟我抢。
lines.en: (sweeps the broken glass into the dustpan) I'll help too. The broken glass is mine. Nobody fight me for it.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: （拇指在结上按了按）别乱动。
lines.en: (presses her thumb on the knot again)…Don't move.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 今天这儿就我一个。莉迪亚给家里叫去吃饭了，她推不掉。
lines.en: Just me today. Lydia got called home for dinner. Said she couldn't get out of it.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: （包甩在柜台角，人往窗边一倾）手递过来。
lines.en: (sets her bag on the corner of the counter) Arm out.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 都结住了。
lines.en: The knot's fine.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 我问的又不是结没结。（把那截布条拎起来看了一整圈）没往外洇。还成。
lines.en: I didn't ask about the knot. (pinches the edge of the cloth and looks it over) No seepage. All right.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 窗下那箱是什么？
lines.en: What's that box?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 口粮。
lines.en: Basic food supplies.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 给我放下。我是不是说过这三天别搬重的？你回头就自己往肩上压。
lines.en: Put it down. I said no heavy lifting for three days, and you go carrying it yourself.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 今天不正好第三天。
lines.en: Today's the third day.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 第三天也得算在那三天里头。（从窗口把他往台子上挪的箱子接过来）账你能这么算？
lines.en: The third day is still one of the three.(Takes the box through the window as he lifts it onto the counter) Is that how you do your sums?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 这些得搁哪层？
lines.en: Which shelf are these going on?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 最下头。你查完再递上来。
lines.en: The bottom one. Check them and pass them to me.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: （箱子搁在窗外，一包一包拎起来看，再往台面上送）这包封口是开的。自己吃，别往架上摆。
lines.en: (Sets the box outside, checks each packet, and passes them onto the counter) This one's open. Keep it for yourself. Don't put it out for sale.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 知道了。
lines.en: Mm.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 那筐旧衣服我昨天全翻过。灰的那件扯掉半幅，还能用的我压到最底下了。
lines.en: I sorted the basket of old clothes yesterday. Half the gray one was torn up; I put the rest at the bottom.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: （直起身，拍两下膝盖，脸没转过来）……喂。
lines.en: (Stands and pats her knees, doesn't turn around)...Hey.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 我在。
lines.en: Here.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 那天他们抓莉迪亚，你一伸手，我还以为你这条胳膊要废了。
lines.en: When they grabbed Lydia and you stuck your arm out, I thought you'd lose the use of it.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 后来给你换布，你还跟我说不疼。
lines.en: And when I changed the dressing, you told me it didn't hurt.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: （手指把一张纸翻来覆去抹平）有句话，那天我没敢说。
lines.en: (Presses a sheet of paper flat, over and over) There was something I couldn't bring myself to say that day.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 我喜欢你。
lines.en: I like you.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 埃莉诺。
lines.en: Eleanor.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 喊我干嘛。
lines.en: What?

blocks.label_en: Moving Goods — Put down your work

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: （把手里那袋货放回柜面）
lines.en: (Sets the package back on the counter)

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 接着码呀，刚才不是挺忙的。
lines.en: Keep stacking. You looked busy a second ago.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: （等了会儿，见他不接话，才慢慢转回身）……你还挺能等。
lines.en: (Waits a moment, sees he hasn't spoken, then turns around)...You're good at waiting.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 别动。
lines.en: Hold still.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 她探过柜台，在他脸边很快地啄了一下。
lines.en: She leans across the counter and quickly brushes his cheek.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: （退回原处，抄起包）走了。
lines.en: (Pulls back, grabs her bag) I'm going.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 货还摊着。剩下的都是轻的，你自己弄完。
lines.en: The goods aren't stacked. Stack the rest yourself. The light ones.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 埃莉诺——
lines.en: Eleanor—

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: （已经往后让出两步）别追。也别问。
lines.en: (Already two steps away) Don't follow me. Don't ask, either.

choices.description_en: Don't interrupt her.
Just her name.

choices.description_zh: 停下手上的事听她说完。
choices.description_en: Stop and hear her out.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 看吧，这结又松了。你单手系的，我猜得准吧？
lines.en: Oh, that knot on your arm is loose again! You tied it with one hand, didn't you? I knew it.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: （趁他胳膊搭在窗沿，她低头把布条重新绕紧）行了，别乱挣。
lines.en: (Waits for him to put his arm through the window and reties the cloth) There. Stop moving it about.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 这身不是平时那套。
lines.en: You're dressed different today.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 你居然看出来了？我还当你只盯价签。
lines.en: You noticed? I thought you only knew price tags.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 那顿饭吃完胃里一直堵。回家先换衣服。那身不想穿到窗口这儿来。
lines.en: That dinner at home gave me a stomachache. I changed as soon as I got back. Didn't want to wear that to see... to come here.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 治安部那边回话了吗？
lines.en: Any word from the security office?

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 有，报告多了半页，说那三个人这几天没在配给站露面。先不追了。
lines.en: Yeah. Another half page. Says those three haven't shown up at the ration station lately. I'm not dealing with them for now.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 老板，我今天来，是想跟你说件正事。
lines.en: Boss, I've come to talk business today.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 讲。
lines.en: Talk.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 我想把你整个人买下来。
lines.en: I want to buy you.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: （她自己先僵住了）……你先别笑。
lines.en: (She goes still.) …Don't laugh.

blocks.label_en: Name a Price — Ask what she means

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 把话说清楚。
lines.en: What do you mean.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 就是……哎呀，你让我从哪儿说起。
lines.en: It's… Oh, where do you want me to start?

blocks.label_en: Name a Price — Have her sit and talk

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 先坐。
lines.en: Sit down. Talk.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: （她刚坐下又弹起来）还是站着吧。
lines.en: (She sits down and springs back up.) I'll stand.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 我不卖。
lines.en: I'm not for sale.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 那……你明天能歇一天吗？
lines.en: Then… could you take tomorrow off?

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 两千。窗口关一天，少做的生意算我的。
lines.en: Two thousand. Keep the window shut for a day. I'll cover what you lose.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 钱从哪儿来的？
lines.en: Where'd the money come from?

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 我自己攒的。
lines.en: I've been saving up.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 你给句实话，两千抵不抵得过你一天进账？不抵我再……
lines.en: Just tell me—is two thousand enough to cover a day's business? If not, I'll...

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: （她把手从钱袋上挪开）就两千。
lines.en: (She takes her hand off her purse.) Two thousand.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 刚才那句我在路上练过的。练得拐错了条巷子。
lines.en: I practised that line on the way here. Turned down the wrong alley doing it.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 明天。早上开门的点。
lines.en: Tomorrow. At opening time.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: （她往后让了一步，又扭头看他）明早，我来窗口等你。
lines.en: (Steps back, then looks at him again) I'll come and wait for you tomorrow morning.

choices.description_en: Draw the line first.
Make her spell it out.
Get her to sit down first.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 你这卷帘拉得真慢。我都在外头站了半天，配给站排队的人往我这边看了好几轮。
lines.en: You took ages to raise the shutter. I've been out here so long the ration queue kept looking over.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 你到得早。
lines.en: You came early.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 我怕你改主意，先把窗口占住。（两手按在柜沿上），头一个到的肯定是我。
lines.en: I was afraid you'd change your mind, so I got to the window first.(Plants both hands on the counter edge) See? Your first visitor today is me.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 今天不做生意，说好的啊。
lines.en: No shop today. We agreed.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 嗯，不做生意。
lines.en: We agreed.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: （往后挪了半步，两只手背到身后） 那你……总得说一句。
lines.en: (steps back half a step, hands behind her back) Then... just say it.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 说哪句？
lines.en: Say what?

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 衣服还是昨天那身，我今早站在镜子前把发夹换了三回，末了留这个。
lines.en: Same outfit as yesterday. I tried three different hair clips in the mirror this morning, and I still went with this one.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: （点了点头）
lines.en: (nods once)

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 光点头啊？我想听你说。
lines.en: A nod? I want to hear you say it.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 小点声，旁边有人往这儿看。
lines.en: Keep your voice down. People are watching.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 他们爱看就看。你还没回我，到底好不好看？
lines.en: Let them look. You still haven't said it. Does it look good?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 确实好看。
lines.en: It looks good.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: ……你回得这么干脆，我下一句都没想好。
lines.en: ...You said that so fast, I wasn't ready for it.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 我昨晚差点把位子都订了。
lines.en: I nearly booked us a table last night.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 那去哪儿？
lines.en: So where to?

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 你定。哪怕就在这儿坐一天，光看那块表走，我也行。
lines.en: You choose. I'd be fine sitting here all day looking at that watch of yours.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 走起来再看。
lines.en: Let's see where we end up.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 好，老板。
lines.en: All right, boss.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 窗口的卷帘落了下去。
lines.en: The window shutter comes down.

choices.description_en: Answer her directly.
Nod once.
Ask her to keep her voice down.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 早。你今天还开着？我还以为你会接着歇一天。
lines.en: Morning! You're open today? I thought you'd take another day off.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 昨晚回去怎么都睡不实，后来索性坐起来，把发夹一枚一枚收进盒子里。
lines.en: I couldn't sleep at all after I got back last night. Tossed and turned forever, then I just sat up and put all my hairpins in a box.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 收起来做什么。
lines.en: Why pack them up?

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 说不上来，手没处搁。（在柜台前挪了挪步子）埃莉诺这两天来过没有？
lines.en: I don't know. My hands wouldn't stay still. (Turns halfway around by the counter) Has Eleanor come by these last two days?

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 我去她住处敲过门，她室友只说她不在。她以前不这么躲我。
lines.en: I went to her place and knocked. Her roommate said she went out. She doesn't usually dodge me like this.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 你直说吧，我最近是不是太闹腾，她烦了？
lines.en: Just tell me—is she tired of me being so loud lately?

blocks.label_en: Stop — Have her sit down first

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 先坐好。
lines.en: Sit down first.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 你这么讲，我更没着落了。（还是坐了下去）说吧，我坐定了。
lines.en: You saying that makes me even more uneasy. (Sits down anyway) Go on. I'm sitting.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 你那天来之前，想过她吗？
lines.en: When you came that day, did you think about her?

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 想了。我盘算的是不瞒她，就一天……你怎么忽然问这个？
lines.en: Of course I did. I thought I wasn't going behind her back, just for one day... Why do you ask?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 你来开价的前一天，埃莉诺来过。就她一个人。
lines.en: The day before you came to name your price, Eleanor came by. Alone.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 她说喜欢我。亲了我一下就走了。
lines.en: She said she liked me. Gave me a kiss and left.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: （手指从柜台撤回来，捏住手镯）前一天。她抢在我前头了。
lines.en: (She draws her fingers off the counter and grips her bracelet.) The day before. She beat me to it.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 那你……你当时怎么回她的？
lines.en: Then what… what did you say to her?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 那是我和她之间的事。
lines.en: That's between her and me.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 那你昨天怎么不说呀？我还非要你夸我好看。
lines.en: Why didn't you tell me yesterday? And there I was, making you say I looked pretty.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: ……对不起，老板。
lines.en: …Sorry, boss.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 那两千别退。你昨天关了一天门。
lines.en: Keep the two thousand. You were shut all day yesterday.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 还去找她吗？
lines.en: Still going to see her?

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 去啊。……最好还是她室友来开门。
lines.en: I am. …I hope her roommate gets the door again.

choices.label_en: Tell her straight about that day
choices.description_zh: 把埃莉诺先告白的事说出来。
choices.description_en: Say that Eleanor confessed first.
Let her get steady first.
Ask what she thinks first.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: （她用肘弯支着窗台）老板，跟你报个喜。
lines.en: (She props an elbow on the sill.) Good news, boss.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 我刚去见过埃莉诺。
lines.en: I went to see Eleanor.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 把咱们那天在外头的事都跟她说了。
lines.en: I told her about our date that day.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 她没听完就抬手拦我，说了句“知道，你接着讲”。（她学她那样，把下巴往上一扬），就这神气。
lines.en: Halfway through she raised a hand to stop me and said, "I know. Keep going." (Copying how she lifts her chin) Just like that.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 后来她自己跟我说，她亲过你。我那杯水端到一半，又放下了。
lines.en: Then she told me she'd kissed you. I had my glass halfway to my mouth. I put it down.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 你俩……挺好的。那我走啦。
lines.en: You two… I'm glad. Well, I'll be off.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: （人刚背过去，又转回窗口跟前）……
lines.en: (Turns to leave, then comes back to the window)...

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 等等，莉迪亚。
lines.en: Lydia.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 她肩头一抖。
lines.en: Her shoulders jerk.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 哎呀，丢脸死了。（她用手背胡乱抹，末了手掌还按在窗框上）
lines.en: Ugh, so embarrassing. (Wipes with the back of her hand, making it worse)

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 我，喜欢你。
